```{r}
# Load all packages needed
if(!require(here)){install.packages("here", dep=T); library(here)}
if(!require(egg)){install.packages("egg", dep=T); library(egg)}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidybayes)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)
library(patchwork)

```

```{r}
# Read in Bee Data
bee_data <- read_rds(here("data", "bee_data.rds"))
sd(bee_data$y)
summary(bee_data$y)
any(bee_data$t <= 0 | bee_data$t >= 1)   # should be FALSE
all(is.finite(bee_data$y))               # should be TRUE
range(bee_data$t) 
bee_data |> filter(abs(y) < 1e-8)

# the 8 extreme low-loss rows, sorted
bee_data |> filter(y < -6) |> arrange(y) |> select(state, year, quarter, max_colonies, lost_colonies, t, y)

```

```{r}
# Alphabetical, AL at the top
bee_data$state <- factor(bee_data$state, levels = rev(sort(unique(bee_data$state))))

fsiz <- 8  # prints at true 8 pt because of the ggsave size below

base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = fsiz) +
  theme(panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text          = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.tag           = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size    = unit(0.35, "cm"))

box_layer <- geom_boxplot(linewidth = 0.15, width = 0.8, color = "black",
                          outlier.size = 0.6, outlier.shape = 21,
                          position = position_dodge(width = 0.85))

p1 <- ggplot(bee_data, aes(x = t, y = state, fill = quarter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(bee_data$t), color = "red", linetype = "twodash") +
  box_layer +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.675), breaks = seq(0, 0.6, 0.1),
                     expand = c(0.005, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Normalized colony loss", y = NULL, tag = "a") +
  base_theme

p2 <- ggplot(bee_data, aes(x = varroa, y = state, fill = quarter)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(bee_data$varroa), color = "red", linetype = "twodash") +
  box_layer +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
                     expand = c(0.005, 0)) +
  labs(x = expression(bold("Normalized ")*bolditalic("Varroa destructor")),
       y = NULL, tag = "b") +
  base_theme +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

p <- (p1 | p2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave("state.pdf", p, path = here("Plots"),
       width = 6.5, height = 8.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
p1<-ggplot(datdes, aes(x=varroa, y=t, 
                       color=Quarter, fill=Quarter)) +
  geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.5)  +
  geom_smooth(formula = y ~ x,

        axis.text = element_text(colour = 1, size = 5),
        legend.background = element_rect(linetype = 1, size = 0.25, colour = 1)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20,face="bold")) +

        axis.text.y = element_text(size=16)) +
```

```{r}
# map
statelab = as.character(datdes$state)
statelab[statelab=="NorthDakota"] = "North Dakota"
statelab[statelab=="SouthDakota"] = "South Dakota"
statelab[statelab=="NewJersey"] = "New Jersey"
statelab[statelab=="NewMexico"] = "New Mexico"
statelab[statelab=="NewYork"] = "New York"
statelab[statelab=="WestVirginia"] = "West Virginia"
statelab[statelab=="SouthCarolina"] = "South Carolina"
statelab[statelab=="NorthCarolina"] = "North Carolina"

if(!require(robustbase)){install.packages("robustbase", dep=T); library(robustbase)}
if(!require(usmap)){install.packages("usmap", dep=T); library(usmap)}

datdes2= datdes
dim(datdes)
datdes2$state = statelab
ns = length(unique(datdes2$state))
ad = as.data.frame(matrix(NA, ns, ncol(datdes2)))
colnames(ad) = names(datdes2)
dim(ad)
periods <- sort(unique(datdes2$quarter))
for (myper in seq_along(periods)){
  period_val <- periods[myper]
  for (i in 1:ns) {
    tmp = datdes2[datdes2$quarter == period_val & datdes2$state == unique(statelab)[i], ]
    itmp = sapply(tmp, is.numeric)
    ad[i, itmp] = colMedians(as.matrix(tmp[, itmp]))
    ad$state[i] = unique(statelab)[i]
  }
  ad$lost = ad$t
  labuse = F
  fsiz=12
  p1 = plot_usmap(data = ad, exclude = c("AK", "HI"),
                  values = "lost", color = "black", 
                  labels=labuse, label_color="white", size=0.5) + 
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size=fsiz),
          legend.text = element_text(size=fsiz)) +
    scale_fill_continuous(low="darkgreen", high="darkred", 
                          guide="colorbar",na.value="lightgray",
                          name = "Normalized\nColony\nLoss") 
  p1$layers[[2]]$aes_params$size <- 3
  # print(p1)
  
  p2 = plot_usmap(data = ad, exclude = c("AK", "HI"),
                  values = "tmin_mean", color = "black", 
                  labels=labuse, label_color="white", size=0.5) + 
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size=fsiz),
          legend.text = element_text(size=fsiz)) +
    scale_fill_continuous(low="blue", high="darkred", 
                          guide="colorbar",na.value="lightgray",
                          name =  "Mean\nMinimum\nTemp.") 
  p2$layers[[2]]$aes_params$size <- 3
  # print(p2)
  
  p3 = plot_usmap(data = ad, exclude = c("AK", "HI"),
                  values = "tmin_kurt", color = "black", 
                  labels=labuse, label_color="white", size=0.5) + 
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size=fsiz),
          legend.text = element_text(size=fsiz)) +
    scale_fill_continuous(low="blue", high="darkred", 
                          guide="colorbar",na.value="lightgray",
                          name =  "Kurtosis\nMinimum\nTemp.") 
  p3$layers[[2]]$aes_params$size <- 3
  # print(p3)
  
  p4 = plot_usmap(data = ad, exclude = c("AK", "HI"),
                  values = "tmin_skew", color = "black", 
                  labels=labuse, label_color="white", size=0.5) + 
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size=fsiz),
          legend.text = element_text(size=fsiz)) +
    scale_fill_continuous(low="blue", high="darkred", 
                          guide="colorbar",na.value="lightgray",
                          name =  "Skewness\nMinimum\nTemp.")  
  p4$layers[[2]]$aes_params$size <- 2
  # print(p4)
  
  figure <- ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4,
                      labels = c("a", "b", "c", "d"),
                      ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
  print(figure)
  
  if (myper==1) {
    print("Figure 5")
  } else if (myper>1) {
    print(paste0("Figure S", myper+10))
  }

ggsave(filename = paste0("map_period", myper, ".pdf"),
           plot = print(figure),
           path = imgPth,
           width = 9.2,
           height = 6.15,
           units = "in",
           dpi = "retina",
           device = cairo_pdf)
}
```

```{r}
reddatdes2 = datdes2
reddatdes2$lost = reddatdes2$t
# pearson correlation between losses and tmin
ycor = reddatdes2$lost
hist(ycor, 30)
xcor = reddatdes2$tmin_mean
hist(xcor, 30)
print(cor.test(ycor,xcor))
plot(xcor, ycor)
summary(lm(ycor~xcor))
abline(lm(ycor~xcor), col="blue")
cor.test(xcor,ycor)
length(ycor)
# t-tests for skewness and kurtosis (higher vs lower losses wrt median)

myper1 = "Q2"
myper2 = "Q3"
reddatdes2 = datdes2[datdes2$quarter == myper1 | datdes2$quarter == myper2, ]
reddatdes2$lost = reddatdes2$t
myind = reddatdes2$lost > median(reddatdes2$lost)
length(myind)
print(t.test(reddatdes2$tmin_kurt[myind], reddatdes2$tmin_kurt[!myind]))
print(t.test(reddatdes2$tmin_skew[myind], reddatdes2$tmin_skew[!myind]))
print("tests for 'Up-scaling weather data' Section")
```
